name: Thunderbolt Display Brightness
description:
Brightness slider in Quick Settings for the Apple Thunderbolt Display (27 inch, 2011, USB ID 05ac:9227), which takes brightness over USB instead of DDC/CI.

Requires the acdcontrol command line tool, built with its 1023 brightness cap removed, plus a udev rule so your user can reach the display. Setup steps are on the homepage.
